design: Toarmet randomiseret klinisk forsøg; én 90-minutters eksponeringssession; opfølgning efter én uge
intervention: Eksponeringssession med eksplicit fokus på brud på trusselsforventninger
comparator: Eksponeringssession uden eksplicit fokus på brud på trusselsforventninger
verification_notes: PubMed-resumé kontrolleret. Ingen forskelle mellem betingelserne i frygtreaktioner eller PTSD-symptomer; trusselsvurdering faldt mere ved fokus på forventningsbrud og så ud til at mediere symptomændringen. Fuldtekst, analysepopulation og numeriske effekter er ikke udtrukket.

design: Seksarmet, randomiseret, tredobbeltblindet og placebokontrolleret 3×2-eksperiment med pavlovsk frygtkonditionering over tre dage
intervention: Enkeltdosis natriumbutyrat før eller efter udslukningsindlæring; antal udslukningsforsøg varieret
claim_direction: Betinget gevinst på trusselsforventning efter syv dage; ingen tydelig hovedeffekt på hudledning eller forebyggelse af genindsættelse
verification_notes: Resumé og metadata fra primærartiklen i Nature kontrolleret. Gevinst på forventningsmål afhænger af robust udslukning med mange forsøg; numeriske effekter og fuldtekstens domænevurdering af bias er ikke udtrukket. Raske laboratoriedeltagere; ikke evidens for behandlingseffekt ved PTSD.

population: Medarbejdere/omsorgspersoner ved SOS Børneby i Sydafrika; ikke en PTSD-population
design: Uden kontrolgruppe, enkeltarms pilot over 10 uger; 23 tilmeldte, 21 gennemførte
intervention: Ugentlig instruktion og gruppeøvelser i TRE/SUTT samt anbefalet selvstændig træning 2–3 gange om ugen
claim_direction: Positivt signal i udvalgte selvrapporterede livskvalitetsmål før/efter
effect_metric: forskel i rå gennemsnit før/efter i én gruppe
verification_notes: Primærartiklens fuldtekst kontrolleret. Ingen kontrolgruppe; to af 23 forlod forsøget efter første dag; selvrapporterede mål; kun udvalgte livskvalitetsændringer. Udvikleren oplyste om royalties. Beregnede konfidensintervaller for ændring før/efter er ikke behandlingseffekter.

population: Japanese adult outpatients with PTSD (single center; 54/60 women)
intervention: Cognitive Processing Therapy plus treatment as usual (n=29)
claim_direction: positive exploratory functional and symptom outcomes vs waitlist at 17 weeks
verification_notes: SDS functional impairment: 8.16-point mean-change difference favoring CPT-TAU at 17 weeks; all secondary analyses exploratory. Patient-reported function, not direct behavior. Single-center trial; no active therapy comparator; assessor blinding failed at weeks 17 and 34; medication changes unrestricted.

claim_direction: positive treatment outcomes through 1–2 year follow-up
verification_notes: Abstract reports significant treatment effects across measures and improvement rates 49% week 6, 80% week 12, 85% week 24, 83% at 1–2 years. The 2007 symptom analysis is the same cohort. No directly observed approach/avoidance task confirmed.

population: Earthquake survivors with PTSD; parent cohort N=59
design: Symptom-level secondary analysis of prior randomized trial
intervention: Parent trial: single-session live exposure/self-exposure instructions
verification_notes: Same BASOGLU_2005_SSBT cohort; one week-6 between-group effect reported for avoidance symptom. Symptom-level analysis, not direct behavioral observation; no effect estimate/CI extracted.

population: Military personnel and veterans with combat-related PTSD
claim_direction: no significant between-format difference on self-reported functioning
verification_notes: SDS and B-IPF are patient-reported function/disability measures. Between-format contrasts at baseline-to-1 month and month 1-to-6 were nonsignificant; active comparison, not PE vs no treatment.

population: US veterans with PTSD and relationship dysfunction
design: Two-site randomized equivalence trial; 3- and 6-month follow-up
claim_direction: no detected IPT superiority on interpersonal or secondary functioning outcomes
verification_notes: IIP-32 primary; WSAS and WHOQOL-BREF secondary. All patient-reported. Six-month IIP IPT-minus-PE difference 6.2 (95% CI -1.9 to 14.3; p=.13). Nonsignificance is not equivalence.

population: US veterans with PTSD or subsyndromal PTSD in primary care
design: Randomized controlled trial; assessments to 24 weeks
comparator: Primary Care Mental Health Integration usual care (PCMHI-TAU)
claim_direction: both groups improved; no between-group functional difference reported
verification_notes: WHODAS self-reported function. Abstract reports improvement from baseline in both conditions with no between-group differences; numeric WHODAS estimate/CI not extracted.

design: Single-site randomized controlled supported-employment trial; 12-month follow-up
verification_notes: Competitive employment 76% vs 28%; eligible work weeks 42% vs 16%; income $9,264 vs $2,601. Participation outcomes, not fear-learning outcomes. Distinct trial from VIP-STAR 2018.

population: Unemployed US veterans with PTSD at 12 VA centers
verification_notes: Steady employment: 105/271 (38.7%) IPS vs 63/270 (23.3%) TW; OR 2.14 (95% CI 1.46–3.14). 2019 PRFI paper reuses this cohort.

population: Unemployed US veterans with PTSD; VIP-STAR cohort
design: Secondary functional-outcome analysis of multisite randomized trial; 18-month follow-up
verification_notes: Secondary analysis of same VIPSTAR NCT01817712 sample as Davis 2018. PRFI decrease indicates less PTSD impact on function; LS-means difference -3.92 (95% CI -7.49 to -0.36; p=.03). Patient report, not a new cohort.
